thoughts: The current TRIPTYCH layout, while clean, lacks the visual friction required to exceed the 2000ms dwell time threshold. Users scan the identical card structures horizontally and move on too quickly. My strategy shifts to a FORENSIC_GRID to emphasize evidence-based outcomes. This layout treats the testimonials as 'dossiers' of success, using varied card sizes and isolated data points to force deeper eye-tracking. I am also increasing the contrast on the data metrics (the 'evidence') to ensure the ROI is immediately legible, which drives conversion for high-level logistics and transit decision-makers.
